```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(here)
  library(pgenlibr)
})

here::i_am(".git/HEAD")

repo_root <- here()
code_dir <- here("code", "11_eQTL_coloc")
source(file.path(code_dir, "utils.R"), chdir = FALSE)

tqtl_in_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tqtl_in")
tqtl_out_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tqtl_out")
tables_dir <- here("processed-data", "11_eQTL_coloc", "seurat", "tables")
plots_dir <- here("plots", "11_eQTL_coloc", "boxplots")
plink2_prefix <- here("processed-data", "00_genotypes", "plink2", "merged_maf05")
full_deg_pdf_file <- file.path(plots_dir, "eqtl_boxplot_degs_broad_union.pdf")

context_order <- names(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID)
disorders <- c("BD", "MDD", "SCZD")
publication_pdf_width <- 3.5
publication_pdf_height <- 5
dx_palette <- c(NTC = "#7F7F7F", MDD = "#FB8861", BD = "#9260B2")
sex_shape_values <- c(Male = 16, Female = 18)
sex_point_size_values <- c(Male = 2, Female = 2.3)

## change to TRUE to run the full DEG boxplot PDF generation
RUN_FULL_DEG_BOXPLOT_PDF <- FALSE

dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
assert_files <- function(paths) {
  missing <- paths[!file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop("Missing required file(s):\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

assert_cols <- function(dt, cols, label) {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(dt))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop("Missing columns in ", label, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

safe_plot_slug <- function(x) {
  gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)
}

save_eQTL_boxplot_pdf <- function(plot, filename,
                                  width = publication_pdf_width,
                                  height = publication_pdf_height) {
  out_file <- file.path(plots_dir, filename)
  grDevices::pdf(out_file, width = width, height = height, onefile = TRUE)
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  print(plot)
  out_file
}

eQTL_boxplot_title <- function(eqtl_row) {
  row <- as.data.table(eqtl_row)[1]
  rsid <- if ("rsid" %in% names(row)) row$rsid else NA_character_
  variant_label <- if (!is.na(rsid) && nzchar(rsid)) {
    rsid
  } else {
    row$variant_id
  }
  paste0(row$context, ": ", row$gene_name, " ", variant_label)
}

pdf_page_count <- function(pdf_file) {
  if (!nzchar(Sys.which("gs"))) return(NA_integer_)
  page_count_ps <- tempfile("eqtl_pdf_page_count_", fileext = ".ps")
  on.exit(unlink(page_count_ps), add = TRUE)
  writeLines(
    paste0("(", normalizePath(pdf_file), ") (r) file runpdfbegin pdfpagecount = quit"),
    page_count_ps
  )
  page_count <- system2(
    "gs",
    c("-q", "-dNOSAFER", "-dNODISPLAY", page_count_ps),
    stdout = TRUE
  )
  as.integer(page_count[length(page_count)])
}

pdf_page_text <- function(pdf_file, page) {
  if (!nzchar(Sys.which("mutool"))) {
    stop("mutool is required to validate PDF text.")
  }
  err_file <- tempfile("mutool_pdf_text_", fileext = ".err")
  on.exit(unlink(err_file), add = TRUE)
  system2(
    "mutool",
    c("draw", "-F", "txt", "-o", "-", pdf_file, as.character(page)),
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = err_file
  )
}

save_eQTL_boxplots <- function(eqtl_dt, filter_dataset_id = NULL, out_file,
                               axis_mode = "ref", plot_style = "publication",
                               gwas_disorder = "MDD",
                               shape_by_sex = FALSE,
                               width = publication_pdf_width,
                               height = publication_pdf_height) {
  axis_mode <- match.arg(axis_mode, c("ref", "gwas_effect"))
  plot_style <- match.arg(plot_style, c("publication", "current"))
  dt <- as.data.table(copy(eqtl_dt))
  assert_cols(
    dt,
    c("dataset_id", "context", "gene_id", "gene_name", "phenotype_id", "variant_id", "pval_nominal"),
    "eqtl_dt"
  )
  if (!is.null(filter_dataset_id)) {
    dt <- dt[dataset_id == filter_dataset_id]
  }
  if (nrow(dt) == 0L) {
    stop("No eQTL rows", if (!is.null(filter_dataset_id)) paste0(" for ", filter_dataset_id) else ".")
  }

  if (!"rsid" %in% names(dt)) {
    dt[, rsid := rsid_lut$rsid[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)]]
  }
  dt[is.na(rsid), rsid := ""]

  dt[, context_order_rank := match(context, context_order)]
  setorder(dt, context_order_rank, gene_name, gene_id, pval_nominal, variant_id)
  dt[, context_order_rank := NULL]
  dir.create(dirname(out_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  grDevices::pdf(out_file, width = width, height = height, onefile = TRUE)
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  gwas_lut <- if (axis_mode == "gwas_effect") read_gwas_effect_lut(gwas_disorder) else NULL

  ## group by domain/cluster so each context is loaded once per PDF.
  for (context_id in unique(dt$dataset_id)) {
    context_dt <- dt[dataset_id == context_id]
    ctx <- load_plot_context(context_id, gene_ids = unique(context_dt$phenotype_id))
    dosage <- load_pgen_dosage(unique(context_dt$variant_id))
    ori <- build_orientation_lut(unique(context_dt$variant_id))

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(context_dt))) {
      row <- context_dt[i]
      pobj <- plot_eQTL_boxplots(
        row$dataset_id,
        row,
        axis_mode = axis_mode,
        gwas_disorder = gwas_disorder,
        title = eQTL_boxplot_title(row),
        plot_style = plot_style,
        shape_by_sex = shape_by_sex,
        plot_context = ctx,
        dosage_mat = dosage,
        orientation_lut = ori,
        gwas_lut = gwas_lut
      )
      print(pobj$plot)
    }
  }
  out_file
}

read_pvar <- function(prefix) {
  pvar_file <- paste0(prefix, ".pvar")
  assert_files(pvar_file)
  pvar <- fread(pvar_file, sep = "\t", skip = "#CHROM")
  setnames(pvar, "#CHROM", "CHROM", skip_absent = TRUE)
  assert_cols(pvar, c("CHROM", "POS", "ID", "REF", "ALT"), basename(pvar_file))
  pvar[, var_idx := .I]
  setkey(pvar, ID)
  pvar[]
}

read_psam_samples <- function(prefix) {
  psam_file <- paste0(prefix, ".psam")
  assert_files(psam_file)
  psam <- fread(psam_file, sep = "\t")
  id_col <- if ("#IID" %in% names(psam)) "#IID" else if ("IID" %in% names(psam)) "IID" else NA_character_
  if (is.na(id_col)) stop("Cannot find sample ID column in ", psam_file)
  as.character(psam[[id_col]])
}

read_tensorqtl_covars <- function(covar_file) {
  covars_raw <- fread(covar_file, sep = "\t")
  assert_cols(covars_raw, "id", basename(covar_file))

  covar_names <- as.character(covars_raw$id)
  covar_samples <- setdiff(names(covars_raw), "id")
  covar_mat <- t(as.matrix(covars_raw[, ..covar_samples]))
  storage.mode(covar_mat) <- "numeric"
  rownames(covar_mat) <- covar_samples
  colnames(covar_mat) <- covar_names

  ## keep the tensorQTL intercept and remove every other covariate from y.
  if (!"(Intercept)" %in% colnames(covar_mat)) {
    covar_mat <- cbind("(Intercept)" = 1, covar_mat)
  }
  covar_mat[, c("(Intercept)", setdiff(colnames(covar_mat), "(Intercept)")), drop = FALSE]
}

infer_dx <- function(covar_mat) {
  dx <- rep("NTC", nrow(covar_mat))
  names(dx) <- rownames(covar_mat)
  if ("DXMDD" %in% colnames(covar_mat)) dx[covar_mat[, "DXMDD"] == 1] <- "MDD"
  if ("DXBD" %in% colnames(covar_mat)) dx[covar_mat[, "DXBD"] == 1] <- "BD"
  factor(dx, levels = c("NTC", "MDD", "BD"))
}

infer_sex <- function(covar_mat) {
  if (!"sexF" %in% colnames(covar_mat)) {
    return(factor(rep(NA_character_, nrow(covar_mat)), levels = names(sex_shape_values)))
  }
  sex <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(covar_mat))
  sex[covar_mat[, "sexF"] == 0] <- "Male"
  sex[covar_mat[, "sexF"] == 1] <- "Female"
  factor(sex, levels = names(sex_shape_values))
}

residualize_expression <- function(expr_mat, covar_mat) {
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr_mat), rownames(covar_mat)))
  x <- covar_mat
  y <- t(expr_mat)

  fit <- lm.fit(x = x, y = y)
  fit_resid <- fit$residuals
  if (is.null(dim(fit_resid))) {
    fit_resid <- matrix(fit_resid, ncol = 1L, dimnames = list(colnames(expr_mat), rownames(expr_mat)))
  }

  ## Plot pure residuals. Legacy plots added the fitted intercept
  ## (`fit_resid + x[, "(Intercept)"] %*% coef["(Intercept)", ]`), matching
  ## jaffelab::cleaningY(..., P = 1), but that offset is a model-reference
  ## baseline rather than a biologically interpretable domain mean.
  adjusted <- t(fit_resid)
  rownames(adjusted) <- rownames(expr_mat)
  colnames(adjusted) <- colnames(expr_mat)
  adjusted
}

read_expr_bed <- function(expr_file, gene_ids = NULL) {
  dt <- fread(expr_file)
  assert_cols(dt, c("#Chr", "start", "end", "ID"), basename(expr_file))
  if (!is.null(gene_ids)) {
    dt <- dt[ID %chin% unique(as.character(gene_ids))]
  }
  if (nrow(dt) == 0L) stop("No requested genes found in ", expr_file)

  sample_cols <- setdiff(names(dt), c("#Chr", "start", "end", "ID"))
  mat <- as.matrix(dt[, ..sample_cols])
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  rownames(mat) <- dt$ID
  colnames(mat) <- sample_cols
  mat
}

load_plot_context <- function(dataset_id, gene_ids = NULL) {
  expr_file <- file.path(tqtl_in_dir, paste0(dataset_id, ".gene.expr.bed.gz"))
  covar_file <- file.path(tqtl_in_dir, paste0(dataset_id, ".gene.covars.txt"))
  assert_files(c(expr_file, covar_file))

  expr <- read_expr_bed(expr_file, gene_ids = gene_ids)
  covars <- read_tensorqtl_covars(covar_file)
  common <- intersect(colnames(expr), rownames(covars))
  if (length(common) == 0L) stop("No shared samples between expression and covariates for ", dataset_id)

  ## use the BED sample order after dropping any unmatched covariate samples.
  expr <- expr[, common, drop = FALSE]
  covars <- covars[common, , drop = FALSE]
  resid <- residualize_expression(expr, covars)

  list(
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    raw_expr = expr,
    resid_expr = resid,
    sample_info = data.table(
      sample_id = common,
      DX = infer_dx(covars),
      Sex = infer_sex(covars)
    ),
    covariates = covars
  )
}
```

```{r genotype-helpers}
parse_variant_id <- function(variant_ids) {
  ids <- data.table(variant_id = unique(as.character(variant_ids)))
  ids <- ids[!is.na(variant_id) & nzchar(variant_id)]
  ids[, c("id_chr", "id_pos", "id_REF", "id_ALT") := tstrsplit(
    variant_id, ":", fixed = TRUE, keep = 1:4
  )]
  ids[]
}

build_orientation_lut <- function(variant_ids, pvar_dt = pvar) {
  ids <- parse_variant_id(variant_ids)
  lut <- pvar_dt[, .(variant_id = ID, pvar_REF = REF, pvar_ALT = ALT, var_idx)]
  setkey(lut, variant_id)
  ori <- lut[ids, on = "variant_id"]

  ori[, orientation_status := fifelse(
    is.na(pvar_REF) | is.na(pvar_ALT), "missing_pvar",
    fifelse(
      id_REF == pvar_REF & id_ALT == pvar_ALT, "aligned",
      fifelse(id_REF == pvar_ALT & id_ALT == pvar_REF, "swapped", "mismatch")
    )
  )]
  ori[, orientation_sign := fifelse(
    orientation_status == "aligned", 1L,
    fifelse(orientation_status == "swapped", -1L, NA_integer_)
  )]
  setkey(ori, variant_id)
  ori[]
}

load_pgen_dosage <- function(variant_ids) {
  vars <- pvar[J(unique(as.character(variant_ids))), nomatch = 0L]
  missing <- setdiff(unique(as.character(variant_ids)), vars$ID)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    stop("Variants missing from pvar/pgen: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  setorder(vars, var_idx)
  pgen <- NewPgen(pgen_file)
  dosage <- ReadList(pgen, vars$var_idx, meanimpute = FALSE)
  rm(pgen)
  gc()

  dosage <- as.matrix(dosage)
  rownames(dosage) <- psam_samples
  colnames(dosage) <- vars$ID
  dosage[, unique(as.character(variant_ids)), drop = FALSE]
}

read_gwas_effect_lut <- function(disorder) {
  disorder <- gwas_check_disorder(disorder)
  dt <- fread(gwas_matched_files[[disorder]], select = c("variant_id", "A1", "A2", "beta", "p"))
  assert_cols(dt, c("variant_id", "A1", "A2", "beta", "p"), basename(gwas_matched_files[[disorder]]))
  dt[, disorder := disorder]
  setkey(dt, variant_id)
  dt[]
}

make_genotype_labels <- function(dosage_vec, allele0, allele1) {
  geno_int <- round(dosage_vec)
  labels <- rep(NA_character_, length(geno_int))
  ok <- !is.na(geno_int) & geno_int %in% 0:2
  if (is.na(allele0) || is.na(allele1) || !nzchar(allele0) || !nzchar(allele1)) {
    labels[ok] <- as.character(geno_int[ok])
    return(labels)
  }
  label_map <- c(
    paste(allele0, allele0, sep = "/"),
    paste(allele0, allele1, sep = "/"),
    paste(allele1, allele1, sep = "/")
  )
  labels[ok] <- label_map[geno_int[ok] + 1L]
  labels
}

expected_ref_genotype_labels <- function(variant_id, dosage_vec = NULL) {
  parsed <- parse_variant_id(variant_id)
  if (nrow(parsed) != 1L) stop("Expected one variant_id.")
  labels <- c(
    paste(parsed$id_REF, parsed$id_REF, sep = "/"),
    paste(parsed$id_REF, parsed$id_ALT, sep = "/"),
    paste(parsed$id_ALT, parsed$id_ALT, sep = "/")
  )
  if (is.null(dosage_vec)) return(labels)

  geno_idx <- sort(unique(round(dosage_vec[!is.na(dosage_vec)])))
  geno_idx <- geno_idx[geno_idx %in% 0:2]
  labels[geno_idx + 1L]
}

validate_ref_axis_dry_run <- function(eqtl_dt) {
  dt <- as.data.table(copy(eqtl_dt))
  assert_cols(dt, "variant_id", "eqtl_dt")
  variants <- unique(dt$variant_id)
  ori <- build_orientation_lut(variants)
  bad_ori <- ori[!orientation_status %chin% c("aligned", "swapped")]
  if (nrow(bad_ori) > 0L) {
    stop("Variant REF/ALT mismatch in pvar: ", paste(bad_ori$variant_id, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dosage <- load_pgen_dosage(variants)
  ## this catches data.table scoping bugs where REF/ALT labels come from a different variant row.
  checks <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(ori)), function(i) {
    this_variant_id <- ori$variant_id[i]
    raw_dosage <- dosage[, this_variant_id]
    plot_dosage <- if (!is.na(ori$orientation_sign[i]) && ori$orientation_sign[i] == -1L) {
      2 - raw_dosage
    } else {
      raw_dosage
    }
    observed_labels <- expected_ref_genotype_labels(this_variant_id, plot_dosage)
    data.table(
      variant_id = this_variant_id,
      orientation_status = ori$orientation_status[i],
      max_noninteger = max(abs(raw_dosage - round(raw_dosage)), na.rm = TRUE),
      dosage_min = min(raw_dosage, na.rm = TRUE),
      dosage_max = max(raw_dosage, na.rm = TRUE),
      expected_axis_labels = paste(observed_labels, collapse = "|")
    )
  }), use.names = TRUE)

  if (any(checks$max_noninteger > 1e-6)) {
    stop("Non-integer dosages detected for REF-axis labels.")
  }
  if (any(checks$dosage_min < -1e-6 | checks$dosage_max > 2 + 1e-6)) {
    stop("Dosage outside 0..2 detected for REF-axis labels.")
  }
  checks[]
}

pdf_ordered_eqtls <- function(eqtl_dt) {
  dt <- as.data.table(copy(eqtl_dt))
  dt[, context_order_rank := match(context, context_order)]
  setorder(dt, context_order_rank, gene_name, gene_id, pval_nominal, variant_id)
  dt[, context_order_rank := NULL]
  dt[, pdf_page := .I]
  dt[]
}

validate_pdf_ref_axis_labels <- function(pdf_file, eqtl_dt, pages) {
  if (!file.exists(pdf_file)) stop("Missing PDF for validation: ", pdf_file)
  ordered_dt <- pdf_ordered_eqtls(eqtl_dt)
  page_dt <- ordered_dt[pdf_page %in% pages]
  if (nrow(page_dt) != length(pages)) {
    stop("Missing requested page metadata for PDF validation.")
  }

  axis_checks <- validate_ref_axis_dry_run(page_dt)
  setkey(axis_checks, variant_id)

  for (page in pages) {
    row <- page_dt[pdf_page == page][1]
    text_lines <- trimws(pdf_page_text(pdf_file, page))
    text_lines <- text_lines[nzchar(text_lines)]
    expected_labels <- strsplit(axis_checks[J(row$variant_id), expected_axis_labels], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    missing_labels <- setdiff(expected_labels, text_lines)
    if (length(missing_labels) > 0L) {
      stop(
        "PDF page ", page, " has wrong genotype x-axis labels for ", row$variant_id,
        ". Missing expected labels: ", paste(missing_labels, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

format_variant_label <- function(variant_id) {
  rsid <- rsid_lut$rsid[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)]
  if (length(rsid) == 1L && !is.na(rsid) && nzchar(rsid)) {
    sprintf("%s (%s)", variant_id, rsid)
  } else {
    variant_id
  }
}
```

```{r plot-function}
plot_eQTL_boxplots <- function(plot_dataset_id, eqtl_pairs, axis_mode = c("ref", "gwas_effect"),
                               gwas_disorder = "MDD", use_raw = FALSE,
                               title = "auto",
                               plot_style = c("publication", "current"),
                               shape_by_sex = FALSE,
                               plot_context = NULL,
                               dosage_mat = NULL,
                               orientation_lut = NULL,
                               gwas_lut = NULL) {
  axis_mode <- match.arg(axis_mode)
  plot_style <- match.arg(plot_style)
  eqtl_pairs <- as.data.table(copy(eqtl_pairs))
  assert_cols(eqtl_pairs, c("phenotype_id", "variant_id"), "eqtl_pairs")
  if (!"gene_name" %in% names(eqtl_pairs)) eqtl_pairs[, gene_name := phenotype_id]
  if (nrow(eqtl_pairs) == 0L) stop("No eQTL pairs supplied.")

  ctx <- if (is.null(plot_context)) {
    load_plot_context(plot_dataset_id, gene_ids = eqtl_pairs$phenotype_id)
  } else {
    plot_context
  }
  expr <- if (isTRUE(use_raw)) ctx$raw_expr else ctx$resid_expr
  dosage <- if (is.null(dosage_mat)) {
    load_pgen_dosage(eqtl_pairs$variant_id)
  } else {
    dosage_mat
  }

  common_samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(colnames(expr), rownames(dosage), ctx$sample_info$sample_id))
  if (length(common_samples) == 0L) stop("No shared samples for plotting ", plot_dataset_id)
  expr <- expr[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
  dosage <- dosage[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  sample_info <- ctx$sample_info[match(common_samples, sample_id)]
  if (!"Sex" %in% names(sample_info)) {
    sample_info[, Sex := factor(rep(NA_character_, .N), levels = names(sex_shape_values))]
  }
  if (isTRUE(shape_by_sex) && anyNA(sample_info$Sex)) {
    stop("Cannot assign point shapes because sex metadata are missing or not encoded as sexF = 0/1.")
  }

  missing_genes <- setdiff(eqtl_pairs$phenotype_id, rownames(expr))
  if (length(missing_genes) > 0L) {
    stop("Genes missing from expression BED for ", plot_dataset_id, ": ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
  }
  missing_variants <- setdiff(eqtl_pairs$variant_id, colnames(dosage))
  if (length(missing_variants) > 0L) {
    stop("Variants missing from preloaded dosage for ", plot_dataset_id, ": ", paste(missing_variants, collapse = ", "))
  }

  ori <- if (is.null(orientation_lut)) {
    build_orientation_lut(eqtl_pairs$variant_id)
  } else {
    as.data.table(orientation_lut)
  }
  setkey(ori, variant_id)
  if (axis_mode == "gwas_effect" && is.null(gwas_lut)) {
    gwas_lut <- read_gwas_effect_lut(gwas_disorder)
  }

  plot_parts <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(eqtl_pairs)), function(i) {
    gene_id <- eqtl_pairs$phenotype_id[i]
    this_variant_id <- eqtl_pairs$variant_id[i]
    gene_name <- eqtl_pairs$gene_name[i]

    orow <- ori[J(this_variant_id)][1]
    if (is.na(orow$orientation_status) || orow$orientation_status == "missing_pvar") {
      stop("Missing pvar orientation for ", this_variant_id)
    }

    raw_dosage <- dosage[, this_variant_id]
    orientation_mode <- "ref"
    axis_status <- orow$orientation_status
    allele0 <- orow$id_REF
    allele1 <- orow$id_ALT
    plot_dosage <- if (!is.na(orow$orientation_sign) && orow$orientation_sign == -1L) 2 - raw_dosage else raw_dosage

    if (axis_mode == "gwas_effect") {
      grow <- gwas_lut[J(this_variant_id)][1]
      if (!is.na(grow$A1) && nzchar(grow$A1)) {
        a1 <- toupper(grow$A1)
        a2 <- toupper(grow$A2)
        ref <- toupper(orow$pvar_REF)
        alt <- toupper(orow$pvar_ALT)

        if (a1 == alt) {
          plot_dosage <- raw_dosage
          allele0 <- a2
          allele1 <- a1
          orientation_mode <- paste0(gwas_disorder, "_A1_effect")
          axis_status <- "gwas_A1_is_ALT"
        } else if (a1 == ref) {
          plot_dosage <- 2 - raw_dosage
          allele0 <- a2
          allele1 <- a1
          orientation_mode <- paste0(gwas_disorder, "_A1_effect")
          axis_status <- "gwas_A1_is_REF"
        } else {
          axis_status <- "gwas_allele_mismatch_ref_fallback"
        }
      } else {
        axis_status <- "missing_gwas_ref_fallback"
      }
    }

    genotype_labels <- make_genotype_labels(plot_dosage, allele0, allele1)
    genotype_order <- unique(genotype_labels[order(plot_dosage)])
    genotype_order <- genotype_order[!is.na(genotype_order)]

    slope <- if ("slope" %in% names(eqtl_pairs)) eqtl_pairs$slope[i] else NA_real_
    pval <- if ("pval_nominal" %in% names(eqtl_pairs)) eqtl_pairs$pval_nominal[i] else NA_real_
    fdr <- if ("fdr" %in% names(eqtl_pairs)) eqtl_pairs$fdr[i] else NA_real_
    perm <- if ("pval_perm" %in% names(eqtl_pairs)) eqtl_pairs$pval_perm[i] else NA_real_

    data.table(
      sample_id = common_samples,
      expression = as.numeric(expr[gene_id, ]),
      genotype = factor(genotype_labels, levels = genotype_order),
      dosage = plot_dosage,
      dosage_raw = raw_dosage,
      DX = sample_info$DX,
      Sex = sample_info$Sex,
      dataset_id = plot_dataset_id,
      gene_id = gene_id,
      gene_name = gene_name,
      variant_id = this_variant_id,
      facet = sprintf("%s\n%s", format_variant_label(this_variant_id), gene_name),
      orientation_mode = orientation_mode,
      axis_status = axis_status,
      slope = slope,
      pval_nominal = pval,
      fdr = fdr,
      pval_perm = perm
    )
  })

  plot_dt <- rbindlist(plot_parts, use.names = TRUE)
  annot <- plot_dt[, .(
    slope = unique(slope)[1],
    pval_nominal = unique(pval_nominal)[1],
    fdr = unique(fdr)[1],
    pval_perm = unique(pval_perm)[1]
  ), by = facet]
  annot[, label := sprintf("beta = %.3g\np = %.2e", slope, pval_nominal)]

  context_label <- manifest[dataset_id == plot_dataset_id, context][1]
  if (is.na(context_label)) context_label <- plot_dataset_id
  if (nrow(eqtl_pairs) == 1L) {
    rsid <- if ("rsid" %in% names(eqtl_pairs)) eqtl_pairs$rsid[1] else NA_character_
    variant_label <- if (!is.na(rsid) && nzchar(rsid)) rsid else eqtl_pairs$variant_id[1]
    auto_title <- paste0(context_label, ": ", eqtl_pairs$gene_name[1], " ", variant_label)
  } else {
    auto_title <- paste0(context_label, ": ", paste(unique(eqtl_pairs$gene_name), collapse = ", "))
  }
  title_to_use <- if (identical(title, "auto")) auto_title else title
  x_label <- if (plot_style == "publication") "Genotype" else ""
  if (axis_mode == "gwas_effect") {
    x_label <- paste0("Genotype ordered by ", gwas_disorder, " GWAS A1 effect allele")
  }
  y_label <- if (isTRUE(use_raw)) "Expression (tensorQTL BED)" else "Residualized expression"
  box_alpha <- if (plot_style == "publication") 0.5 else 0.55
  box_linewidth <- if (plot_style == "publication") 0.5 else 0.45
  box_color <- if (plot_style == "publication") "gray70" else "gray45"
  jitter_width <- if (plot_style == "publication") 0.2 else 0.18
  jitter_alpha <- if (plot_style == "publication") 0.8 else 0.85
  annot_hjust <- if (plot_style == "publication") 1.1 else 1.05
  y_expand <- if (plot_style == "publication") c(0.16, 0.05) else c(0.18, 0.08)
  if (plot_style == "publication" && !isTRUE(use_raw)) {
    y_label <- "Residualized Expression"
  }

  point_layer <- if (isTRUE(shape_by_sex)) {
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = DX, shape = Sex, size = Sex),
      width = jitter_width, height = 0, alpha = jitter_alpha
    )
  } else {
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = DX),
      width = jitter_width, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = jitter_alpha
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = genotype, y = expression)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = box_alpha, linewidth = box_linewidth, color = box_color, fill = "gray90") +
    point_layer +
    geom_text(
      data = annot,
      aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label),
      hjust = annot_hjust, vjust = -0.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ facet, scales = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = dx_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = y_expand)) +
    labs(
      title = title_to_use,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      color = "Dx",
      shape = "Sex"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = if (plot_style == "publication") 10 else 12, lineheight = 1.05),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  if (isTRUE(shape_by_sex)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_shape_manual(values = sex_shape_values, drop = FALSE) +
      scale_size_manual(values = sex_point_size_values, guide = "none", drop = FALSE) +
      guides(
        shape = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
        color = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
      ) +
      theme(legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "center")
  }

  list(plot = p, data = plot_dt)
}
```

```{r load-manifest-and-select-examples}
manifest <- load_eqtl_manifest(
  tqtl_in_dir = tqtl_in_dir,
  context_order = context_order,
  split_order = "all"
)

sig_file <- file.path(tables_dir, "map_significant_unified.csv.gz")
if (!file.exists(sig_file)) {
  sig_file <- file.path(tables_dir, "map_independent_significant.csv.gz")
}
nominal_file <- file.path(tables_dir, "nominal_BH05.csv.gz")
assert_files(c(sig_file, nominal_file))

sig <- fread(sig_file)
nominal <- fread(nominal_file)
assert_cols(sig, c("dataset_id", "context", "split", "gene_id", "gene_name", "phenotype_id", "variant_id", "DEG", "MDD_gwasVar_strict", "MDD_gwas_strict", "pval_nominal"), basename(sig_file))
assert_cols(nominal, c("dataset_id", "context", "split", "gene_id", "gene_name", "phenotype_id", "variant_id", "DEG", "MDD_gwasVar_strict", "MDD_gwas_strict", "fdr", "pval_nominal"), basename(nominal_file))

degs <- load_DEGs(repo_root = repo_root, mode = "standard", verbose = FALSE)
mdd_deg_ids <- unique(as.data.table(degs$disorder_related$global$MDD)$gene_id)
bd_deg_ids <- unique(as.data.table(degs$disorder_related$global$BD)$gene_id)

## use disorder-related DEG lists for disorder-targeted examples.
sig[, `:=`(
  MDD_DEG = as.integer(gene_id %in% mdd_deg_ids),
  BD_DEG = as.integer(gene_id %in% bd_deg_ids)
)]
nominal[, `:=`(
  MDD_DEG = as.integer(gene_id %in% mdd_deg_ids),
  BD_DEG = as.integer(gene_id %in% bd_deg_ids)
)]

sig_candidates <- sig[split == "all" & MDD_DEG == 1L & MDD_gwas_strict == 1L]
sig_deg_basis <- "MDD_DEG"
if (nrow(sig_candidates) == 0L) {
  sig_candidates <- sig[split == "all" & DEG == 1L & MDD_gwas_strict == 1L]
  sig_deg_basis <- "broad_DEG"
}
if (nrow(sig_candidates) == 0L) {
  sig_candidates <- sig[split == "all" & MDD_DEG == 1L]
  sig_deg_basis <- "MDD_DEG_no_MDD_gwas"
}
if (nrow(sig_candidates) == 0L) {
  sig_candidates <- sig[split == "all" & DEG == 1L]
  sig_deg_basis <- "broad_DEG_no_MDD_gwas"
}
if (nrow(sig_candidates) == 0L) {
  sig_candidates <- sig[split == "all"]
  sig_deg_basis <- "none"
}
if (nrow(sig_candidates) == 0L) stop("No significant examples found.")
## prioritise variant-level GWAS hits, then curated gene-list hits, then the rest.
sig_candidates[, example_priority := fifelse(MDD_gwasVar_strict == 1L, 1L, fifelse(MDD_gwasGene == 1L, 2L, 3L))]
setorder(sig_candidates, example_priority, pval_nominal)
sig_examples <- head(sig_candidates[, .SD[1], by = gene_id], 3L)
sig_examples[, example_type := "mdd_significant"]
sig_examples[, example_deg_basis := sig_deg_basis]

sig_keys <- unique(sig[split == "all", .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)])
nominal_l23 <- nominal[split == "all" & dataset_id == "l2-3"]
nominal_only <- nominal_l23[!sig_keys, on = .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)]
nominal_only <- nominal_only[MDD_DEG == 1L & MDD_gwas_strict == 1L]
nominal_deg_basis <- "MDD_DEG"
if (nrow(nominal_only) == 0L) {
  nominal_only <- nominal_l23[!sig_keys, on = .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)]
  nominal_only <- nominal_only[DEG == 1L & MDD_gwas_strict == 1L]
  nominal_deg_basis <- "broad_DEG"
}
if (nrow(nominal_only) == 0L) {
  nominal_only <- nominal_l23[!sig_keys, on = .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)]
  nominal_only <- nominal_only[MDD_DEG == 1L]
  nominal_deg_basis <- "MDD_DEG_no_MDD_gwas"
}
if (nrow(nominal_only) == 0L) {
  nominal_only <- nominal_l23[!sig_keys, on = .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)]
  nominal_only <- nominal_only[DEG == 1L]
  nominal_deg_basis <- "broad_DEG_no_MDD_gwas"
}
if (nrow(nominal_only) == 0L) {
  nominal_only <- nominal_l23[!sig_keys, on = .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)]
  nominal_deg_basis <- "none"
}
if (nrow(nominal_only) == 0L) stop("No L2.3 nominal-only examples found.")
setorder(nominal_only, fdr, pval_nominal)
nominal_examples <- head(nominal_only[, .SD[1], by = gene_id], 2L)
nominal_examples[, example_type := "l2-3_nominal_only"]
nominal_examples[, example_deg_basis := nominal_deg_basis]

example_cols <- unique(c(
  "example_type", "example_deg_basis", "dataset_id", "context", "split", "gene_id", "gene_name",
  "phenotype_id", "variant_id", "DEG", "MDD_DEG", "BD_DEG", "MDD_gwasVar_strict", "MDD_gwas_strict",
  "MDD_gwasGene", "pval_nominal", "fdr",
  "pval_perm", "qval", "qval_parent", "slope", "slope_se"
))
examples <- rbindlist(
  list(sig_examples[, intersect(example_cols, names(sig_examples)), with = FALSE],
       nominal_examples[, intersect(example_cols, names(nominal_examples)), with = FALSE]),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)
setcolorder(examples, c(intersect(example_cols, names(examples)), setdiff(names(examples), example_cols)))

## attach dbSNP IDs from the genotype-wide variant cache.
examples[, `:=`(
  rsid = rsid_lut$rsid[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)],
  rsid_source = rsid_lut$rsid_source[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)]
)]
examples[is.na(rsid), rsid := ""]
examples[is.na(rsid_source), rsid_source := ""]
missing_example_rsids <- examples[!nzchar(rsid), unique(variant_id)]
if (length(missing_example_rsids) > 0L) {
  stop("Missing rsIDs for example variants: ", paste(missing_example_rsids, collapse = ", "))
}

expected_example_rsids <- c(
  "chr9:133345514:A:G" = "rs2129965621",
  "chr8:27240919:C:T" = "rs1562330",
  "chr4:1209477:T:C" = "rs1250105",
  "chr2:232708988:G:C" = "rs35395584",
  "chr1:9292645:C:G" = "rs114709597"
)
observed_example_rsids <- setNames(examples$rsid, examples$variant_id)
expected_ids <- names(expected_example_rsids)
bad_example_rsids <- expected_ids[
  is.na(observed_example_rsids[expected_ids]) |
    observed_example_rsids[expected_ids] != expected_example_rsids
]
if (length(bad_example_rsids) > 0L) {
  stop("Unexpected genotype VCF rsIDs for examples: ", paste(bad_example_rsids, collapse = ", "))
}

examples_file <- file.path(tables_dir, "eqtl_boxplot_examples.csv")
fwrite(examples, examples_file)
examples
```

```{r mapk3-all-clusters-fixed-axis, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
MAPK3_GENE_ID <- "ENSG00000102882"
MAPK3_GENE_NAME <- "MAPK3"
MAPK3_VARIANT_ID <- "chr16:30123335:T:C"
mapk3_contexts <- c("Micro.Vasc", "Astro", "L2.3", "L4", "Inhb", "L5", "L6", "Oligo")
mapk3_dataset_ids <- unname(SEURAT_CONTEXT_TO_DATASET_ID[mapk3_contexts])
mapk3_plot_width <- publication_pdf_width * 4
mapk3_plot_height <- publication_pdf_height * 2
mapk3_size_scale <- 1.35
mapk3_table_file <- file.path(tables_dir, "MAPK3_chr16_30123335_all_clusters.csv")
mapk3_pdf_file <- file.path(plots_dir, "MAPK3_chr16_30123335_all_clusters.pdf")
mapk3_png_file <- file.path(plots_dir, "MAPK3_chr16_30123335_all_clusters.png")

read_mapk3_nominal_row <- function(dataset_id) {
  parquet_file <- file.path(tqtl_out_dir, paste0(dataset_id, ".gene.cis_qtl_pairs.chr16.parquet"))
  assert_files(parquet_file)
  cols <- c(
    "phenotype_id", "variant_id", "start_distance", "af", "ma_samples",
    "ma_count", "pval_nominal", "slope", "slope_se"
  )
  dt <- as.data.table(arrow::read_parquet(parquet_file, col_select = tidyselect::all_of(cols)))
  assert_cols(dt, cols, basename(parquet_file))
  out <- dt[phenotype_id == MAPK3_GENE_ID & variant_id == MAPK3_VARIANT_ID]
  if (nrow(out) != 1L) {
    stop("Expected exactly one MAPK3 row in ", basename(parquet_file), "; found ", nrow(out))
  }
  out[, dataset_id := dataset_id]
  out[]
}

mapk3_nominal <- rbindlist(lapply(mapk3_dataset_ids, read_mapk3_nominal_row), use.names = TRUE)
mapk3_meta <- manifest[split == "all" & dataset_id %chin% mapk3_dataset_ids,
                       .(dataset_id, context, split)]
if (nrow(mapk3_meta) != length(mapk3_dataset_ids)) {
  stop("Missing all-donor manifest rows for MAPK3 plot.")
}
mapk3_nominal <- mapk3_meta[mapk3_nominal, on = "dataset_id"]
mapk3_nominal[, `:=`(
  gene_id = MAPK3_GENE_ID,
  gene_name = MAPK3_GENE_NAME,
  rsid = rsid_lut$rsid[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)],
  rsid_source = rsid_lut$rsid_source[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)]
)]
mapk3_nominal[is.na(rsid), rsid := ""]
mapk3_nominal[is.na(rsid_source), rsid_source := ""]

mapk3_bh05 <- nominal[
  split == "all" & gene_id == MAPK3_GENE_ID & variant_id == MAPK3_VARIANT_ID,
  .(dataset_id, fdr)
]
mapk3_nominal <- mapk3_bh05[mapk3_nominal, on = "dataset_id"]
mapk3_nominal[, fdr_source := fifelse(is.na(fdr), "not_in_nominal_BH05", "nominal_BH05")]
mapk3_nominal[, context_order_rank := match(context, mapk3_contexts)]
setorder(mapk3_nominal, context_order_rank)
mapk3_nominal[, context_order_rank := NULL]

if (!identical(mapk3_nominal$dataset_id, mapk3_dataset_ids)) {
  stop("MAPK3 nominal rows are not in expected Seurat context order.")
}
if (any(!nzchar(mapk3_nominal$rsid))) {
  stop("Missing rsID for MAPK3 variant: ", MAPK3_VARIANT_ID)
}
missing_mapk3_pvar <- setdiff(MAPK3_VARIANT_ID, pvar$ID)
if (length(missing_mapk3_pvar) > 0L) {
  stop("MAPK3 variant missing from pvar: ", paste(missing_mapk3_pvar, collapse = ", "))
}

mapk3_dosage <- load_pgen_dosage(MAPK3_VARIANT_ID)
mapk3_orientation <- build_orientation_lut(MAPK3_VARIANT_ID)
mapk3_plot_parts <- lapply(mapk3_dataset_ids, function(ds) {
  pair <- mapk3_nominal[dataset_id == ds]
  ctx <- load_plot_context(ds, gene_ids = MAPK3_GENE_ID)
  pobj <- plot_eQTL_boxplots(
    ds,
    pair,
    axis_mode = "ref",
    title = "auto",
    plot_style = "publication",
    plot_context = ctx,
    dosage_mat = mapk3_dosage,
    orientation_lut = mapk3_orientation
  )
  out <- copy(pobj$data)
  out[, context := pair$context[1]]
  out[]
})
mapk3_plot_dt <- rbindlist(mapk3_plot_parts, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
mapk3_plot_dt[, context := factor(context, levels = mapk3_contexts)]
mapk3_plot_dt[, genotype := factor(as.character(genotype), levels = expected_ref_genotype_labels(MAPK3_VARIANT_ID))]
mapk3_plot_dt <- mapk3_plot_dt[!is.na(genotype)]

mapk3_counts <- mapk3_plot_dt[, .(
  n_samples = .N,
  n_NTC = sum(DX == "NTC"),
  n_MDD = sum(DX == "MDD"),
  n_BD = sum(DX == "BD"),
  expression_min = min(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
  expression_max = max(expression, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(dataset_id, context)]
mapk3_counts[, context := as.character(context)]
mapk3_nominal <- mapk3_counts[mapk3_nominal, on = .(dataset_id, context)]
fwrite(mapk3_nominal, mapk3_table_file)

mapk3_annot <- unique(mapk3_nominal[, .(
  context = factor(context, levels = mapk3_contexts),
  slope,
  pval_nominal
)])
mapk3_annot[, label := sprintf("beta = %.3g\np = %.2e", slope, pval_nominal)]

mapk3_variant_label <- if (nzchar(mapk3_nominal$rsid[1])) {
  sprintf("%s (%s)", MAPK3_VARIANT_ID, mapk3_nominal$rsid[1])
} else {
  MAPK3_VARIANT_ID
}
mapk3_y_range <- range(mapk3_plot_dt$expression, finite = TRUE)
mapk3_y_pad <- diff(mapk3_y_range) * 0.08
if (!is.finite(mapk3_y_pad) || mapk3_y_pad == 0) mapk3_y_pad <- 0.5
mapk3_y_limits <- mapk3_y_range + c(-mapk3_y_pad, mapk3_y_pad)

mapk3_plot <- ggplot(mapk3_plot_dt, aes(x = genotype, y = expression)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5 * mapk3_size_scale,
    color = "gray70", fill = "gray90"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = DX), width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 2 * mapk3_size_scale, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    data = mapk3_annot,
    aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label),
    hjust = 1.08, vjust = -0.25, size = 3 * mapk3_size_scale, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ context, nrow = 2, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = dx_palette, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = mapk3_y_limits, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(MAPK3_GENE_NAME, " ", mapk3_variant_label, " across Seurat clusters"),
    x = "Genotype",
    y = "Residualized Expression",
    color = "Dx"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10 * mapk3_size_scale, lineheight = 1.05),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11 * mapk3_size_scale),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9 * mapk3_size_scale),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10 * mapk3_size_scale),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9 * mapk3_size_scale),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9 * mapk3_size_scale)
  )

print(mapk3_plot)
ggsave(mapk3_pdf_file, mapk3_plot, width = mapk3_plot_width, height = mapk3_plot_height, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
ggsave(mapk3_png_file, mapk3_plot, width = mapk3_plot_width, height = mapk3_plot_height, dpi = 300)
stopifnot(
  file.exists(mapk3_table_file), file.info(mapk3_table_file)$size > 0L,
  file.exists(mapk3_pdf_file), file.info(mapk3_pdf_file)$size > 0L,
  file.exists(mapk3_png_file), file.info(mapk3_png_file)$size > 0L,
  uniqueN(mapk3_plot_dt$context) == length(mapk3_contexts)
)
list(table = mapk3_table_file, pdf = mapk3_pdf_file, png = mapk3_png_file)
```

```{r prepare-deg-plot-pairs}
sig_deg_pairs <- copy(sig[split == "all" & DEG == 1L])
if (nrow(sig_deg_pairs) == 0L) stop("No significant broad DEG eQTL pairs found.")

sig_deg_pairs[, context_order_rank := match(context, context_order)]
setorder(sig_deg_pairs, context_order_rank, gene_name, gene_id, pval_nominal, variant_id)
sig_deg_pairs <- sig_deg_pairs[, .SD[1], by = .(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id)]
sig_deg_pairs[, context_order_rank := match(context, context_order)]
setorder(sig_deg_pairs, context_order_rank, gene_name, gene_id, pval_nominal, variant_id)

sig_plot_degs <- copy(sig_deg_pairs)
sig_plot_degs[, `:=`(
  example_type = "broad_deg_significant",
  example_deg_basis = "broad_DEG"
)]
setcolorder(sig_plot_degs, c(
  "example_type", "example_deg_basis",
  setdiff(names(sig_plot_degs), c("example_type", "example_deg_basis"))
))

## attach dbSNP IDs from the genotype-wide variant cache.
sig_plot_degs[, `:=`(
  rsid = rsid_lut$rsid[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)],
  rsid_source = rsid_lut$rsid_source[match(variant_id, rsid_lut$variant_id)]
)]
sig_plot_degs[is.na(rsid), rsid := ""]
sig_plot_degs[is.na(rsid_source), rsid_source := ""]

core_plot_cols <- c("dataset_id", "gene_id", "phenotype_id", "variant_id")
for (col in core_plot_cols) {
  bad <- is.na(sig_plot_degs[[col]]) | !nzchar(as.character(sig_plot_degs[[col]]))
  if (any(bad)) stop("Missing ", col, " in sig_plot_degs.")
}

expected_sig_plot_degs_rows <- sig_deg_pairs[, uniqueN(paste(dataset_id, gene_id, variant_id, sep = "\r"))]
if (nrow(sig_plot_degs) != expected_sig_plot_degs_rows) {
  stop("Unexpected sig_plot_degs row count: ", nrow(sig_plot_degs), " != ", expected_sig_plot_degs_rows)
}
if (nrow(sig_plot_degs) != 263L) {
  stop("Current sig_plot_degs row count is not 263: ", nrow(sig_plot_degs))
}
if ("disorder" %in% names(sig_plot_degs)) {
  stop("sig_plot_degs should not contain a disorder column.")
}

missing_deg_pvar <- setdiff(sig_plot_degs$variant_id, pvar$ID)
if (length(missing_deg_pvar) > 0L) {
  stop("DEG plot variants missing from pvar: ", paste(missing_deg_pvar, collapse = ", "))
}

for (ds in unique(sig_plot_degs$dataset_id)) {
  expr_file <- file.path(tqtl_in_dir, paste0(ds, ".gene.expr.bed.gz"))
  dt <- fread(expr_file, select = "ID")
  missing_genes <- setdiff(sig_plot_degs[dataset_id == ds, phenotype_id], dt$ID)
  if (length(missing_genes) > 0L) {
    stop("DEG plot genes missing from expression BED for ", ds, ": ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
  }
}

sig_plot_deg_counts <- sig_plot_degs[, .(
  n_deg_egenes = uniqueN(gene_id),
  n_eqtl_pairs = uniqueN(paste(gene_id, variant_id, sep = "\r")),
  n_variants = uniqueN(variant_id),
  n_pairs_with_rsid = uniqueN(paste(gene_id, variant_id, sep = "\r")[nzchar(rsid)])
), by = .(context, dataset_id)]
sig_plot_deg_counts[, context_order_rank := match(context, context_order)]
setorder(sig_plot_deg_counts, context_order_rank)
sig_plot_deg_counts[, context_order_rank := NULL]

sig_plot_degs_file <- file.path(tables_dir, "eqtl_boxplot_deg_pairs.csv")
fwrite(sig_plot_degs, sig_plot_degs_file)
message("Wrote DEG plot pair metadata: ", sig_plot_degs_file)
sig_plot_deg_counts
```

```{r test-deg-pdf-save, include=FALSE}
test_deg_pdf <- file.path(plots_dir, "eqtl_boxplot_degs_broad_union_uvasc.pdf")
saved_test_deg_pdf <- save_eQTL_boxplots(
  sig_plot_degs,

  preview_png <- tempfile("eqtl_boxplot_degs_broad_union_uvasc_", fileext = ".png")

    c(
      "-q", "-dSAFER", "-dBATCH", "-dNOPAUSE", "-sDEVICE=png16m",
      "-dFirstPage=1", "-dLastPage=1", "-r144",
      paste0("-sOutputFile=", preview_png),
      saved_test_deg_pdf
    )
  )
  stopifnot(gs_status == 0L, file.exists(preview_png), file.info(preview_png)$size > 0L)
  unlink(preview_png)
}
```
